The '''1930–31 season''' was '''[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]'s''' [[List of Real Madrid C.F. seasons|29th season]] in existence, and their [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time La Liga table|3rd consecutive season]] in the [[La Liga|Primera División]]. The club also played in the [[Campeonato Regional Centro]] (Central Regional Championship) and the [[Copa del Rey]].

The establishment of the [[Second Spanish Republic]] in April 1931 caused Real Madrid Club de Fútbol to lose the title "Real" and the royal crown from their crest and badge, and Real Madrid went back to being named Madrid Football Club.
